name: search_jokes
description: Searches for joke information based on description and category.

description.description: A description specifying the required content of retrieved jokes.

category.description: Joke category, supports fuzzy matching (case-insensitive), e.g. Animal,Other / Misc,Bar,One Liners,Puns,Lawyer,Sports,Medical,News / Politics,Men / Women,Gross,Blond,Yo Momma,Redneck,Religious,At Work,College,Lightbulb,Children,Insults,Knock-Knock,Tech,Yo Mama,Blonde
